83015: Yuuichirou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hiragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He, along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End".
83017: Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise Yuuichirou during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior.
87287: The deuteragonist of the Owari no Seraph series. He is an incomplete vampire and a servant of Third Progenitor Krul Tepes. He was human until Krul Tepes forced him to drink her blood.
88888: The demon into the black series demon blade used by Yuuchirou. It often warns Yuuchirou about how humans are dangerous and can't be trusted.
88899: Krul Tepes is a third progenitor among the vampires and the former vampire queen of Japan. Just like all other vampires, she views the humans as nothing more than livestock. She sees them as foul and endlessly greedy creatures who will do anything for their own personal gain.
88912: Kimizuki is a serious and diligent person. He is competitive against Yuuichirou Hyakuya. He earned the highest test scores in their class, and he is angry when Yuuichirou appears out of nowhere and may earn Cursed Gear before him.
88988: He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality.
88990: He is a seventh progenitor among the vampires. He is the one who killed Yuuichirou's family, thus fueling his desire for revenge against all vampires. On the outside, Ferid acts kind and polite.
88991: She is a Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. She is also the daughter of the prestigious Jujo family.
88992: A Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Although he has a high capacity for spellcraft since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable with being with the Hiiragi Family. Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man.
88993: He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company.
89785: Seishiro Hiiragi is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.
89786: Tenri Hiiragi is the general of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.
90238: Crowley is a Thirteenth Progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. However, he hides his strength under Ferid's orders and is actually equal in strength to a Seventh Progenitor.
127240: Mahiru was from the prestigious Hīragi Clan, and next in line to become head of the family; however, as a namanari, she eventually turned into a demon, and ended up being sealed within Guren's sword, becoming a cursed gear called Mahiru-no-yo.
135241: He is the Lieutenant General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. His goal is to exterminate all the vampires in Japan and find the person who is manipulating the Hīragi family. He and Mahiru were in competition to be the next head of the Hīragi family.
135248: Colonel in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.
135249: She is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. While serving as a member of the Moon Demon Company, she is also an Army instructor for the training classes.
135250: A member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Yuu's team of the Moon Demon Squad. She also the younger sister of Aoi Sanguu. Mitsuba is shown to be a serious and by-the-book soldier, who dislikes those who break the formation and commit to individual action.
135251: She is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. Like Sayuri Hanayori, Shigure is also a servant for the Ichinose Family.
135252: She is the older sister of Mitsuba Sangū and the servant of Kureto Hīragi. She is also part of the Sangū family, one of the three prodigious families serving the Hīragi Family.
135255: Horn Skuld is a vampire noble who serves Thirteenth Progenitor Crowley Eusford. She is fond of both him and her partner, Seventeenth Progenitor Chess Belle, and she can usually be found in their company.
135256: One of the orphans from Hyakuya Orphanage along with Yuuichirou and Mika. Being the eldest in their group, she did the motherly duties for them, such as preparing food.
135257: Chess Belle is a seventeenth progenitor vampire who serves Thirteenth Progenitor Crowley Eusford. Even though she is a noble, her personality is freewheeling gets jealous easily and behavior is very careless.
145964: Makoto is a sergeant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the leader and only surviving member of his squad in the Moon Demon Company.
177482: A team leader in the Moon Demon Company.
177483: Yayoi is a kind-hearted peace keeper of the belligerent Narumi squad. In contrary to her quiet looks, she is brave and has a firm attitude to confront a vampire.
204122: He's a high-ranked possession-type demon of the Black Demon Series. He formed a contract with Shihō Kimizuki and became his Cursed Gear. His weapon form is two twin blades connected by a cord on the hilts.
209534: René Simm is a vampire who often works with Lacus Welt and Mikaela Hyakuya as a city guard. He is tasked with gathering surviving humans to provide a food source for vampires. Thinking objectively in situations, René keeps a clear head in precarious situations.
209535: A vampire belonging to the City Defense Unit and a colleague of Mikaela Hyakuya and René Simm. The person responsible for killing Yoichi Saotome's older sister. Although not a noble, he boasts high combat capabilities.
